integrity: Claims of formal or independent scientific certification are not made; finite numerical checks complement a self-contained mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is proved only for adjacency hopping on the theta graph of path edge lengths 3,3,m, with a source at the opposite terminal from a single irreversible local absorber. It is an infinite-time statement; graph Laplacian hopping, dephasing, disorder, arbitrary sites and finite-time bounds are not treated. The generic dark-subspace method is known; independent publication-priority checking remains outstanding.
title: A twelve-periodic perfect-absorption law for three-path quantum theta networks
